title: the hand-written documentation chapters are LaTeX and have to become Markdown
author: Claude-JG
description: The seven chapters that are still LaTeX - gettingStarted, introduction, tutorial, GUI, notation, theory, solver - are the original sources; the generated .rst does not carry all of their information, so each one is converted by hand-checked machine conversion and then becomes the source itself. tools/tex2md.py is the one-shot converter for it and is deleted again in step R7.1.7. A converted chapter leaves filesParsed in doc2rst.py in the same commit, so that its generated .rst files and their duplicate labels disappear with it. See revision2026 step R7.1.5.
releaseNotes: All seven hand-written chapters are MyST Markdown in docs/manual/ and split into 22 documents named <chapterStem><Section>.md. The theDoc.tex preamble is not converted: it is the LaTeX skeleton and dies with the LaTeX build. tools/tex2md.py did the conversion and is deleted again in step R7.1.7. Each chapter was checked word by word against the .rst Sphinx rendered before it; the only differences are markup tokens, plus three places where the old path was worse - dropped citations, a Windows path whose backslashes were eaten, and the contact theory (7200 words) which had no .rst at all and reaches the HTML for the first time. The conversion also found that conf.py declared only 118 of the 204 math macros, because the old converter expanded them; all 46 the chapters use are declared now and tools/checkMathMacros.py is the eighth check of exudev generate --all-checks. README.rst became hand-written and a document of the documentation (D11), with its version line stamped by issueTracker.py.
